text.description_html:
Entry Set Old Style Omnia Latch

Replacement latch for old-style Omnia entry sets. This Omnia Classic Latch for Entry Sets will not work on current Omnia hardware. This latch is for door with a 2-3/4 inch backset.

Special Orded item. NO RETURNS.
